title: Fix subscription activation bypassing payment flow

requirements.summary: Remove immediate subscription activation from SubscriptionPackagesPage and enforce Stripe payment flow before subscription is recorded
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Subscribe' on any plan in SubscriptionPackagesPage does NOT immediately activate the subscription or update local storage with a new subscription record.
Clicking 'Subscribe' triggers the Stripe checkout flow (redirects to Stripe or shows Stripe configuration prompt if Stripe is not yet configured).
The subscription is only recorded as active after the PaymentSuccess page confirms a valid Stripe session ID.
If Stripe checkout is cancelled or fails, the user is redirected to PaymentFailure and no subscription is recorded.
In demo mode only, a clearly labelled 'Demo Subscribe' simulation is acceptable — but live mode must always require Stripe payment.
The 'subscriptions' localStorage store is not written to from SubscriptionPackagesPage directly outside of demo mode.
Verified by navigating to /subscription as a non-demo authenticated user and confirming that clicking Subscribe redirects to Stripe checkout rather than immediately activating the plan.

file_operations.description: Remove any code that directly writes subscription records to localStorage when Subscribe button is clicked in live mode. The Subscribe button must only initiate Stripe checkout via the useCreateCheckoutSession hook (creating ShoppingItem array from plan details and calling mutateAsync, then redirecting to session.url). If Stripe is not configured, show the StripeSetupModal. Preserve demo mode behavior where clearly labeled 'Demo Subscribe' buttons can simulate subscription activation for testing purposes only. Ensure no subscription is marked as active or stored in localStorage until payment confirmation occurs on PaymentSuccess page.

Verify that this page is the only location where subscriptions are activated and written to localStorage after successful Stripe session verification. Ensure the page reads sessionId from URL params, calls getStripeSessionStatus backend method, parses the StripeSessionStatus response, and only writes to the subscriptions localStorage store when status is 'completed' with valid userPrincipal. If session verification fails or status is not completed, show an error and do not activate subscription. Confirm that this is the single source of truth for subscription activation in live mode.
